title: GAX-P08 - FHIR-AgentBench frozen local R4 dataset qualification
outcome: Qualify or explicitly block the frozen FHIR-AgentBench derived dataset using a zero-founder-cost local/public artifact path, metadata-only provenance evidence, role/leakage audits, and a sealed final-test boundary.
rationale: P08 requires a real interoperable EHR/FHIR benchmark path. FHIR-AgentBench ships a frozen derived CSV in its public repository, so GAX can test whether that artifact is reproducibly usable without GCP or paid APIs while preserving CC BY, EHRSQL, MIMIC ODbL, and provenance constraints.
scope_in: Frozen FHIR-AgentBench derived CSV acquisition and Git blob verification
FHIR-AgentBench, EHRSQL-2024, and MIMIC-IV demo license/provenance record
Deterministic non-test role policy frozen before model comparison
Exact question/source and patient/source overlap audits
R4 identity preservation and read-only GAX conversion contract
Dedicated zero-founder-cost GitHub Actions qualification path
Inventory promotion, retention, or block only according to real evidence
scope_out: No founder-paid cloud or paid model API
No model, threshold, ECAL, or FHIR representation selection
No raw FHIR-AgentBench CSV redistribution from GAX
No patient-level resource content in committed qualification evidence
No clinical-safety, FHIR-conformance, agent-superiority, or SOTA claim
acceptance: The source is pinned to glee4810/FHIR-AgentBench commit bbb42909a5a7eb907d1cd91f72a560729e7037ea and final_dataset/questions_answers_sql_fhir.csv Git blob b2225370feeaefe962c27c4d90f911584e098ac2
The build rejects source bytes whose Git blob SHA-1 does not match the frozen blob
A real-source GitHub Actions probe records only metadata-safe source SHA-256, byte count, exact header, row/split counts, identifier counts, missingness summaries, and aggregate overlap findings
Committed reports contain no raw question, SQL, answer, FHIR ID, patient resource, or patient-level row
FHIR-AgentBench repository/derived artifact CC BY 4.0, EHRSQL-2024 CC BY 4.0, and MIMIC-IV demo ODbL 1.0 obligations are recorded separately
The upstream setup_data.sh unpinned EHRSQL clone is recorded as provenance uncertainty; temporal EHRSQL revision evidence is not represented as proof of the generation revision
GAX does not relicense or commit the upstream derived CSV under Apache-2.0
Upstream split identity is preserved and final-test rows remain sealed
Any GAX calibration role is derived deterministically from non-test membership before model comparison
Cross-role patient/source identity overlap, exact question overlap, and normalized question/template overlap are measured and classified rather than silently ignored
R4 remains model-visible source identity and no semantic R4-to-R5 conversion claim is made
True answers, SQL, and true FHIR IDs are supervision-only and excluded from model-visible state
Qualification artifacts serialize no final-test gold labels
Inventory status changes only to the evidence-supported qualified, pending, or blocked state
Exact-head Linux/Windows Python 3.11/3.12 CI and the dedicated frozen-source qualification job pass before merge
A guarded implementation merge, successful post-main qualification, and separate canonical closeout are required before SG-000015 becomes PROVEN

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000015 files and retain FHIR-AgentBench as pending or blocked. Final-test access remains sealed and no model results are generated in this grain.
